correctness.rationale: The printed convergence ratio and period formula simplify exactly to rho=(1-p2 E_l) exp(-mu T). The logistic log-derivative evaluates the integral, while a direct transverse linearization using psi(0)=0 independently gives the same multiplier. Under the stated strict finite-cycle and biological harvest conditions it is always between zero and one. Example 3.1 with p2 changed to 0.1 gives rho=0.4 although p2 is below the paper's claimed threshold.

value.rationale: The result removes the paper's principal predator-capture stability threshold, changes its biological interpretation of over-harvesting versus persistence, and invalidates the instability premise used for one positive-cycle existence case. The mechanism is structural: the predator Allee condition psi(0)=0 leaves only mortality and pulse removal at linear order near extinction.
